findings.title: Historical exact-input LiveEffectVerified is improperly broadened to action-wide OFFLINE_PLAN_READY
findings.verified_counterexample: Catalog action COACH_SET_KNOWN_CURRENT_SETTINGS has a LiveEffectVerified state only because exact historical evidence has team_id=20, settings RunPlayTendency=55, before=90. Yet the action's input schema accepts general settings and coach_settings.json includes enumerated POEOffense2 values 0 and 7. An intent with team_id=20, settings POEOffense2=7, expected_before {POEOffense2:0}, catalog matching build, matching asserted identity, mode FAST_SIM and arbitrary nonempty before_source passes visible branch checks and can receive OFFLINE_PLAN_READY without the verified exact-input effect.
findings.risk: The plan remains execute=false, so there is no current write. But a later coordinator may treat offline-plan readiness as evidence-qualified for an unverified setting or before-state. The string before_source is not a bound fresh Getter observation.
findings.fix: Preserve historical exact-input metadata at parameter-field level. Separate schema completeness from certified write/effect applicability, require a verifiable Getter/source identity/version/time binding before high-readiness statuses, and keep unverified settings in NEEDS_VALIDATION/SCHEMA_ONLY with execute=false.
acceptance: Action-level maturity cannot authorize unverified field-value pairs.
A fabricated before_source cannot make a current plan evidence-qualified.
Historical RunPlayTendency exact tuple remains reported faithfully, without claiming general applicability.
All plans remain execute=false and Native transport is not introduced.

findings.title: Unverified and synthetic stored observations are emitted as top-level FACT
findings.verified_counterexample: In both historical cases, six inspected diagnostic findings have classification FACT while their supporting knowledge_status is UNVERIFIED_OBSERVATION and data_status=REAL_DATA_NOT_VERIFIED. The role classification branch checks observation availability, numeric value and freshness, but not evidence-grade or source admission; its default requirements have no threshold.
findings.risk: Downstream consumers can read FACT as a verified real-game basketball fact, even though the value is only an unbound archive observation or synthetic fixture; this undermines the BIC epistemic separation.
findings.fix: Separate 'recorded raw value/comparison with caller assumption' from a qualified FACT label. Preserve the actual values, provenance and role-compatibility arithmetic, but expose an evidence-qualified status (e.g. OBSERVED_UNVERIFIED, SYNTHETIC_ONLY, or UNKNOWN for game truth) unless source maturity/identity matches an explicit admission contract. Avoid upgrading an assumption match to native mechanism evidence.
acceptance: Existing historical cases keep raw values but no longer present unverified source as certified FACT.
Synthetic fixture comparisons are identified as synthetic.
Positive certified-source case (when provided) is distinguishable without claiming mechanism effect.

findings.title: Fixed-roster team joins do not bind the observation scope identity
findings.verified_counterexample: _same_context compares save_id, season_id, observed_through, game_mode and game_build, but ignores observation_scope.scope_sha256. Two baselines from different capture-unit sets sharing those visible labels are accepted as a single fixed-roster diagnostic context.
findings.risk: Teams and players may be compared across distinct observations/world snapshots even if their identifiers and requested cutoff match, producing a misleading team/role association.
findings.fix: For a single fixed-world/snapshot diagnosis bind scope_sha256 and an available dataset/source identity; explicitly reject or mark incompatible/UNKNOWN when capture scopes diverge. Do not require matching per-field unit_id inside a legitimate shared scoped ledger, as fields are intentionally multi-unit.
acceptance: Same save/season/cutoff but different scope_sha256 is not silently accepted.
A team and player from a legitimate common ledger scope still work.
Existing save, season, mode and build negative tests stay passing.

findings.title: PlayType negative compatibility can be asserted from an incomplete non-null slot sample
findings.verified_counterexample: player_play_types returns the latest non-null observed value per slot, not an exhaustiveness proof. diagnose_player marks CONFLICT whenever any returned row is fresh and no returned code matches a requested code, even with partial capture completeness or omitted slots.
findings.risk: False negative player role fit when a required PlayType is simply not observed yet.
findings.fix: Separate verified positive registration from absence. Negative CONFLICT needs explicit complete same-scope slot capture or certified exhaustive slots; otherwise UNKNOWN. Preserve stale=UNKNOWN and sourced request assumptions.
acceptance: Fresh partial one-slot sample lacking requested PlayType yields UNKNOWN.
Complete proven inventory with no matching code can yield CONFLICT.
Matching fresh code remains supported without implying a play was executed.
